answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on six vision-language tasks: SNLI-VE, VCR, A-OKVQA, Winoground, MMMU, and MathVista.
answer_1.outputs: Answers to visual questions (multiple-choice or short answers)

answer_2.quote: We use the Brier Score (BS) to measure the correlation between reliability and task accuracy... and Effective Reliability (ER) to evaluate the reliability measurement.

answer_3.quote: We use both the candidate VLM and a separate LLM... to reason over the sub-QA pairs and obtain their respective reasoned answers. We then compare the consistency between these reasoned answers and the answer generated directly by the VLM to measure the reliability...
methods: Consistency comparison between reasoned answers and direct answer
